chain: ds_tail_touch (不许摸尾巴！, 24 frames, loop_section [14, 20] = one tail slam, the app plays 2-3) -> ds_tail_allow (TAIL_ALLOW_CHANCE = 1.0: always). Both animations are in the app atlas; ds_tail_allow_baked is frames-only.

variants.ds_tail_allow: app animation (no text in the frames; the app draws the bubbles)
variants.ds_tail_allow_baked: identical frames with the three speech bubbles drawn in (frames-only)

strips: spritesheets/<variant>.png (60 cells of 256x256, left -> right, frame i at x = 256*i); spritesheets/ds_tail_touch.png = the touch before it

loop_section.note: the offer: repeat 16..27 while waiting (the app waits TAIL_ALLOW_WAIT = 4.0 s)

playback: play 0..27, repeat the loop section 16..27; then EITHER a click on her -> hard cut to frame 28 and play 28..45 (touched) OR no click within ~4 s -> hard cut to frame 46 and play 46..59 (timeout). Frames 28..45 are never shown on the timeout path and vice versa. Both branches end on idle poses.
bubble_note: only in ds_tail_allow_baked; frames outside those ranges are pixel-identical in both variants

gifs.previews/ds_tail_allow.gif: app frames: ds_tail_touch (3 slams) -> ds_tail_allow -> touched
